boundary: Scoped inventory of fourteen previously relevant or newly observed repositories. This is not a claim of exhaustive discovery across all GitHub repositories.
Only public published non-withdrawn records with explicitly accepted B1ueD0g Finder credit from credits_detailed are retained. No pending credit was promoted to accepted.
Unpublished draft or triage records and closed reports are excluded. Their identifiers, titles and technical details are not retained here.
No CVE identifier means only that current advisory metadata lists no CVE. It is not evidence of a rejected CVE request.
A CVE and its GHSA are one disclosure record; a CVE display identifier does not make the underlying vendor GHSA obsolete.
Publication timestamps are the exact GitHub UTC fields. The nine added enclave-os-virtual disclosures were published on 2026-10-20 UTC, corresponding to 2026-10-21 in Asia/Shanghai.
CVE-2026-109358 was published by the CVE Program on 2026-10-12 UTC; 2026-10-26 is the later GitHub advisory updated_at, not its CVE publication date.
This audit verifies public disclosure state, personal credit, and identifier mapping only. It does not independently reproduce any vulnerability or certify impact.
